target_customer: Marketing, insights and brand teams at consumer packaged goods, retail and FMCG companies
problem: Consumer testing for pricing, packaging and campaigns is slow and expensive, so teams decide with little evidence.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI simulated consumer panels
product_category: Synthetic consumer research and digital twin simulation

founders.name: Eytan Rozenblum
founders.background_notes: YC page does not list prior employers or education.

founders.name: Antoine Bertrand
previous_startups: Gaming platform co-founded as CTO, grown to 100k monthly active users (name not given)
founders.background_notes: Five years at Bloomberg building fixed income software per the YC page.

competitors.name: Aaru
competitors.what: Simulated populations that model how audiences react to messages and products
competitors.traction_then: Accenture investment and customer reported in March 2025

technical_complexity.rationale: Building persona simulations on LLMs is standard engineering, but validating accuracy against real survey results (the site claims over 90 percent of the test retest ceiling) is the hard part and is unverified.

defensibility.rationale: Persona models depend on public LLMs, so copying is quick. Any moat would come from calibration data and enterprise relationships, not yet shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals raised large rounds in 2025 and 2026 (Simile reported at 200 million dollars in July 2026), so well funded players moved into the same wedge after founding.

market_need_then: Market research is a large corporate spend and brand teams complain about slow panels. Coverage notes Gallup refuses to publish estimates from simulated responses, so trust in synthetic data was contested.

branding.domain_note: Uses foresight.tt, not an exact .com. Many unrelated companies named Foresight exist.

identity.visual_style: Clean and data driven per the website
identity.voice_and_tone: Scientific and trust focused, headline Consumer testing in minutes, not months

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word shared with many firms; searches for it returned other Foresight companies and no brand press.

outcome_analysis: Foresight is a Spring 2026 company with two founders and still active, with no exit or layoff reports found. Public funding detail is missing, and the only claim of a pre-seed comes from a single aggregator. It sells into a space where Aaru and Simile raised far larger rounds, so its outcome will depend on proving simulation accuracy with named customers such as Caudalie.
notes: Unverified: VCBacked lists a 500k dollar pre-seed in June 2026 with Y Combinator among investors, seen on one aggregator only, so it is not recorded as a round. Other companies named Foresight have unrelated rounds (25M Series A, 5.5M seed) and were excluded. Claims of 2M digital twins and over 90 percent accuracy are company claims. Completeness pass: the 500K June 2026 pre-seed rests on VCBacked alone; a separate VCBacked page for a Brooklyn Foresight carries a June 2026 pre-seed without amount, so the match to this company is not certain. The 25M Series A belongs to another Foresight.
